notes.summary:
Google Docs is a web-based word processor that functions primarily within a web browser, meaning there is no standalone "desktop application" for macOS in the traditional sense. Users access it via `https://docs.google.com`.

### **System Requirements & Versioning**
*   **Requirements:** To ensure the best experience, Google recommends using one of the two most recent versions of your browser (e.g., Google Chrome) with cookies and JavaScript enabled. For Mac users, while the web version runs on any modern macOS, the Google Drive for desktop application requires **macOS Ventura 13.0 or higher**.
*   **Version Note:** There is no "version" number for the web-based Google Docs itself, as it is updated continuously by Google. The mobile app (available on the App Store) is updated frequently; as of November 2026, recent versions include `1.2026.45104`.
*   **Naming History:** Originally launched as "Google Docs & Spreadsheets" in 2006 (based on the acquired product "Writely"), it was later rebranded as part of the Google Drive suite in 2012.

### **Common User Struggles**
Based on help community trends and support topics, users frequently encounter the following issues:
*   **Connectivity & Errors:** Users often report "server errors" or "reload" prompts, usually resolved by checking internet stability, clearing browser extensions, or using an Incognito/Private window to identify interfering plugins.
*   **Formatting Conflicts:** Difficulty maintaining formatting when importing/exporting Microsoft Word (`.docx`) files.
*   **Offline Access:** Confusion regarding offline availability, which requires the Google Chrome browser and the "Google Docs Offline" extension to function reliably.
*   **Collaboration Permissions:** Managing "Editor" vs. "Viewer" access and issues with shared folders counting against storage quotas.

### **Keyboard Shortcuts (Mac)**
Google Docs uses the **Command (⌘)** key for most primary shortcuts.
*   **Common Commands:**
    *   **Bold:** ⌘ + B
    *   **Italic:** ⌘ + I
    *   **Paste without formatting:** ⌘ + Shift + V
    *   **Insert/Edit Link:** ⌘ + K
    *   **Add Comment:** ⌘ + Option + M
*   **Master List:** You can view a complete, searchable list of shortcuts within the document by pressing **⌘ + /**.
*   **Menu Access:** To search the menus (formerly "Tool finder"), press **Option + /**.

### **Key Statistics**
| Metric | Detail | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Active Users** | Over 1 billion monthly active users | |
| **Document Limit** | 1.02 million characters (regardless of pages) | |
| **Corporate Adoption** | Over 213,000 verified companies use Google Docs | |
| **Conversion Limit** | Uploaded Word files must be 50 MB or smaller to convert | |

*Caveat: While character limits are strictly enforced at ~1.02 million, file size limits for non-converted files (stored in Drive) can reach up to 5 TB. Some older documentation may cite a 512,000 character limit, but current standards are higher.*
